headline: Florida Southern's perfect start ends at Saint Leo
dek: Florida Southern had won four without a defeat before going to Saint Leo, where they lost for the first time and let in four of the five goals they have conceded all season. They have still scored fifteen, more than any other programme.
displaced_by: Saint Leo beat Florida Southern, Florida Southern's first defeat after four straight wins

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: The goals are pooled at the top of the chart, not spread through it: Florida Southern alone have outscored Barry, Eckerd and Nova Southeastern put together, and the gap has grown since they last played.

wire.line: Florida Southern's first defeat leaves Embry-Riddle and Lynn as the only unbeaten sides.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Four matches have passed their date with no result: Palm Beach Atlantic's against Florida Atlantic, Barry and Strive Academy, and Eckerd's against Trinity.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Saint Leo have not lost since their opener at AUM, drawing once and winning three, and have scored eleven and conceded nine.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Rollins' first defeat was at home to Embry-Riddle; they have scored eleven and conceded ten, more than any other programme has let in.

findings.label: derived
findings.text: Lynn are still unbeaten and have drawn three in a row away from home since beating Mississippi College in their opener.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Ricardo Marques has kept three clean sheets for Florida Southern and has conceded five goals in all.

last_match.line: Florida Southern's first defeat of the season; Saint Leo are unbeaten since their opener.

next_match.line: Rollins have conceded more than any other side in the conference; Tampa are unbeaten at home.

validation.policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.
